about: Document types the radar recognises, the names people write them under, and a planning default for how many days a renewal takes from booking to having the new document in hand. Lead times are operational estimates, not legal facts: override them per role in requirements.csv. Validity periods are described in shape only and point to the source; the radar never computes an expiry, it reads the one you give it.

dot_medical_card.label: DOT medical card
dot_medical_card.renewal: Book an exam with a certified medical examiner, then get the new certificate on file. Some drivers are certified for less than the maximum period, so their next date can come sooner than expected.
dot_medical_card.validity_shape: A medical examiner's certificate is issued for up to 24 months, and can be shorter when the examiner decides so.

driver_license.label: Driver's licence (incl. CDL)
driver_license.renewal: Renewal goes through the state licensing agency; appointment availability varies widely by state and by season.

forklift_certification.label: Forklift operator evaluation
forklift_certification.renewal: A performance evaluation by someone with the knowledge and experience to train and evaluate, scheduled on site.
forklift_certification.validity_shape: Operator performance is evaluated at least once every three years, and sooner after an incident or a near miss.

food_handler_card.label: Food handler card
food_handler_card.renewal: Usually a short course and test, often online.
food_handler_card.validity_shape: Set by the state or county; commonly a few years.

food_manager_certificate.label: Food protection manager certificate
food_manager_certificate.renewal: A proctored exam that has to be booked.
food_manager_certificate.validity_shape: Set by the certifying body and local rules; commonly several years.

first_aid_cpr.label: First aid / CPR
first_aid_cpr.renewal: A class that runs on fixed dates; seats go quickly before peak season.
first_aid_cpr.validity_shape: Set by the training provider; commonly two years.

alcohol_server_permit.label: Alcohol server permit
alcohol_server_permit.renewal: Usually a short course and test.
alcohol_server_permit.validity_shape: Set by the state or county.

security_guard_license.label: Security guard licence
security_guard_license.renewal: Through the state licensing body; some states require training hours before renewal.

vehicle_insurance.label: Vehicle insurance
vehicle_insurance.renewal: Renewed by the policy holder with their insurer; the employer or platform only needs the new proof on file.
vehicle_insurance.validity_shape: Set by the policy term, commonly six or twelve months.

vehicle_registration.label: Vehicle registration
vehicle_registration.renewal: Through the state motor vehicle agency, sometimes after an emissions or safety inspection.
vehicle_registration.validity_shape: Set by each state, commonly one or two years.

background_check.label: Background check (periodic re-check)
background_check.renewal: A new check, which needs the person's fresh authorisation before it runs. Results can take days, longer when a county record has to be pulled by hand.
background_check.validity_shape: Not an expiry in itself: the re-check date comes from your own policy or your platform's, and for regulated drivers an annual driving-record review is a federal requirement.

refused.about: Work-authorisation documents are deliberately out of scope. Their reverification rules are specific, and tracking them ahead of time in a spreadsheet is how employers end up asking for documents they are not allowed to ask for. Use the employment-verification process and advice built for that. Matching is on the whole document name, so a safety 'hot work permit' or a 'food passport' is not caught.
